profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: White Plains, New York, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained the application RadMetrix:
Reporting application designed and used by the head of radiology to make critical decisions with the department.
Backend C#
Frontend Asp.Net
Database Sql Server

Maintained the application RMID:
Financial application used to settle claims from visits to NYU facilities.
Backend C#
Frontend Asp.Net
Database Sql Server

Responsibilities:
Manage team of 3 developers and 2 quality assurance analysts
Day to day tasks included meeting with business stakeholders to determine further software development
Helped create and assign tasks for development and QA.
Automate the development process with CI/CD
Creating Jenkins jobs to build and deploy to multiple servers
Implementing database migration tools and archive architecture
Coordination of .Net upgrades to ensure the applications are able to utilize the latest technology
Hiring new staff to improve team efficiency 
Ongoing discussion making regarding future enhancements and current software issues
Organizing requirements for release schedules
Collaboration with business partners on critical issues to formulate plans for resolutions
Provided personal insight regarding team member development
positions.insights: Technology Leadership, Managing Technical Personnel and +10 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained the website Techbargains.com:
Backend code Java
CMS for the site written in C#
Database Sql Server
Changed the website technology
Ported the code from Java to C#
Total overhaul of backend and frontend code
Ported the code from C# to PHP
Re-architecured code and redesign of backend, frontend, and CMS
Changed the database from Sql Server to MySQL

Created an app for the website:
Both iOS and Android using Swift and Java
Created a JSON api for the website used by the app
Developed jobs to keep the data synced between the two systems
Worked with Xamarin to keep the iOS and Android under one code base of C#

Maintained the websites BlackFriday.com and TheBlackFriday.com:
Ported the two sites from older frameworks to Laravel PHP
Used the Laravel PHP framework to maintain the frontend, backend, and CMS architecture
Maintained the websites PCMag.com and Best.Offers.com:
Worked on the PCMag port from C# to Laravel PHP
Maintained the Best.Offers CMS as well as the frontend and backend

Maintained the website Offers.com:
Worked on the port from an old framework to Laravel PHP
Made backend changes to support the MySQL database

positions.title: Senior Information Technology Analyst
positions.locationName: Somers, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Wrote a process in Java to track customer representatives in the store which included (Customer Barcode Scanner):
Filtered customer search based on location, territory, and route
An additional filter that allowed the user to control what customers are returned for that location

Customer Integration Project:
Created a system of stored procedures in Sybase that validated the loading of new customers
A daily report stored procedure showing:
All customers processed who had no issues converting as well as those with issues
Missing mapped data used for customers dealing with locations, items, routes, and customer type
Troubleshot issues that came up over the length of the project based on business incidents with the process

Maintained a Sales Tax and Legislative Charge application which consisted of:
Java Web front-end using the Spring framework along with Javascript that allowed internal users to update Legislative Charges, Customer Exemptions, and Sales Taxability of items sold in a state
Sybase and Oracle back-end on Unix to maintain all data for the application
A Sybase stored procedure to help setup data for testing ordering and selling applications
Maintained reports based on sales tax and legislative charges through the Java Web front- end
End of month Sybase stored procedures that maintained customer information by keeping track of tax laws that may have changed periodically
C++ programs on Unix used to transform data from an outside vendor for tax authority information and tax rates to be loaded into the Oracle database
Sybase stored procedures to maintain customer information such as various levels of taxability and tax rates
C++ client / server application on Unix used to obtain tax information in real time such as current tax rates, tax calculations, and location codes for a particular state, city, and zip code
Created Java web service for other applications to get location geocodes and tax rates.
positions.insights: Business Analysis, Business Intelligence and +11 skills
